versions.content: The RTE Generator shall create a conditional call to the Os API Schedule after the execution call of the RunnableEntity if the RteOsSchedule- Point configuration parameter is set to CONDITIONAL . In the generated code the call to the Os API Schedule shall be omitted when there was already a call to the Os API Schedule before without any RunnableEntity execution in between.
